## About Appon Islam
Appon Islam is a dedicated Full Stack Developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He specializes in crafting high-performance, accessible, and scalable web applications using the modern JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystem. With experience across both frontend design implementation and robust backend systems, he builds end-to-end digital solutions.

## Detailed Projects

### 1. Bike Shop Application
- **URL**: [https://www.apponislam.com/projects/bike-shop-application](https://www.apponislam.com/projects/bike-shop-application)
- **Live Demo**: [https://peppy-hotteok-65ea2d.netlify.app/](https://peppy-hotteok-65ea2d.netlify.app/)
- **Frontend Repo**: [https://github.com/apponislam/bike-store-frontend](https://github.com/apponislam/bike-store-frontend)
- **Backend Repo**: [https://github.com/apponislam/bike-store-backend](https://github.com/apponislam/bike-store-backend)
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, JWT, SurjoPay
- **Summary**: Full-featured e-commerce platform for bicycles featuring catalog browsing, advanced filtering, JWT-based role authentication for customers and administrators, order tracking, and SurjoPay payment processing.

### 2. AP Classroom
- **URL**: [https://www.apponislam.com/projects/ap-classroom](https://www.apponislam.com/projects/ap-classroom)
- **Live Demo**: [https://assignmentb9a12.web.app/](https://assignmentb9a12.web.app/)
- **Frontend Repo**: [https://github.com/apponislam/Classrooms-client](https://github.com/apponislam/Classrooms-client)
- **Tech Stack**: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Firebase Auth, Tailwind CSS, Stripe
- **Summary**: Modern learning management platform enabling instructors to create and monetize classes, students to enroll and submit assignments, and administrators to review course approvals and financial metrics.

### 3. Appon Assignment Library
- **URL**: [https://www.apponislam.com/projects/appon-assignment-library](https://www.apponislam.com/projects/appon-assignment-library)
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, MongoDB
- **Summary**: Centralized academic resource portal designed for university students to publish, categorize, preview, and download study assignments, lecture notes, and lab reports.
